title: April 23,2026: Top 5 AI Updates For Today!
description:
AI is no longer just a tool — it’s becoming a full-on coworker.

In today’s AI news, OpenAI introduces workspace agents inside ChatGPT, allowing teams to automate real workflows like reporting, coding, and communication. At the same time, Google is rolling out Workspace Intelligence for Google Workspace, powered by Gemini — turning your entire work environment into one connected AI system.

We also cover former OpenAI researcher Jerry Tworek launching a new AI lab, Core Automation, aiming to fully automate AI research itself. Plus, Perplexity AI is making major breakthroughs in AI-powered search accuracy, and Microsoft is shifting GitHub Copilot to token-based pricing — changing how developers will use AI tools going forward.

If you’re keeping up with artificial intelligence, machine learning, and the future of work, this is everything you need to know today.
